authorizationText: 单独授权 Gate14Re‑ME qualification input schema compatibility corrigendum attempt‑004，按照建议的最小边界执行一次隔离无算法 Unity schema compatibility 自检；允许必要的当前冻结实现编译和一次 Unity 自然启动/退出，使用 attempt‑007 冻结时间戳比较器完成 trusted identity 核验。仍禁止生成调度、输入 bundles、匿名身份映射和 measured root，禁止 planner、算法 lane、正式采集、正式分析、排名及赢家裁决；失败时保留并冻结全部证据，不自动扩大阶段范围。
authorizedActions: create an independent attempt-004 evidence directory
bind and compile the current frozen implementation in an isolated Unity project
launch exactly one algorithm-free Unity process and allow it to exit naturally
run exactly one schema compatibility self-check
use the frozen attempt-007 strict timestamp comparator for trusted launch identity timestamp checks
freeze terminal pass or fail-closed evidence and a new versioned status
requiredChecks: JsonUtility preserves eventGroups[*].topology through serialization and deserialization
matching topology passes and missing or mismatched topology fails for the frozen reason
prelaunch, live-concurrent and post-exit external executable identity satisfy trusted launch identity rule v1
timestamp text is preserved and compared only through the frozen attempt-007 strict DateTimeOffset UTC-ticks comparator
PID, creation time, executable path, command line, execute method and isolated project identity agree
all retained evidence and current source bindings remain unchanged
prohibitedActions: signal or forced termination of Unity
